notes: s005 carries the whole supplied verb *Is … pronounced upon*; giving *Is* to the noun μακαρισμός under rule 63 was the competing reading, but rule 62 sends a supplied verb to the prepositional predicate it predicates of, even against English word order.

s018 ἡ takes the supplied *his* under rule 20's second arm — no possessor word stands in this phrase — against s013 of ROM.4.5, where αὐτοῦ displaces the determiner. The Greek, not the English, decides.
s001 Ὁ is unrepresented under rule 38, the demonstrative οὗτος occupying the determiner slot whether it precedes or follows.
